title: 第7章 住手！
novel_title: 宗门收徒，我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
虽然看见了，但厉行天并没有立刻去拿，而是先再次转身拱手感谢道：

    “多谢前辈。”

    楚星尘摆了摆手，神色淡然。

    厉行天缓缓起身，径直走向那块重生后心心念念的那一块千年骨玉。

    抬起桌角，将石头模样的千年骨玉重新握回手中，厉行天只觉得心中的一块大石头终于放了下来。

    再一次朝楚星尘拱手感谢后，厉行天带着那一枚千年骨玉连忙退出了破庙。

    李应灵看着离去的厉行天，随后也迈步走进了破庙，语气有些奇怪道：

    “师父，你就这样让他走了？”

    没好处都不想动弹的师父，这回怎么这样大方的让人拿了东西就走了？

    听见李应灵的话，楚星尘连忙不再装高人风范：“你自己先在家里练练，为师出去一趟。”

    李应灵露出师父本就该如此的神色，不过在楚星尘走之前，还是好奇问道：

    “师父，我们宗门真的叫天道盟？”

    毕竟师父说的话也不都是实话，也有可能是在骗那个傻小子。

    “是。”楚星尘丢下一句话，便化作一阵虹光离去。

    李应灵摸着自己下巴缓缓思索着什么。

    随后一阵灵力调动，木剑自动飞来，李应灵反手接过。

    还是先练练吧，这本三千弱水剑自己也快入门了。

    李应灵总觉得这本难练的东西，入门之后有质的飞跃。

    从小到大都被称为天才的李应灵，是第一次被这本神通练到没脾气。

    都整整五天时间了！自己居然还只是在入门边缘徘徊。

    也难怪师父着急收新的徒弟，自己的天资想来在师父眼中有些不够看了吧。

    李应灵叹了口气，再努努力吧。

    ——————

    厉行天目标准确，直奔最近的小镇而去。

    炼化这一块千年骨玉需要安静，安全的空间也需要一天的时间。

    原先的沙雕宗门谁回去谁弱智，更何况也回不去，自己是偷偷从宗门里溜出来的。

    现在估计已经被宗门挂上逃宗的红名了。

    去附近的小镇开个客栈，多给点钱那群小二别打扰自己。

    等炼化了千年骨玉后就迅速往中州去，那边还有现在自己可以获得的机缘。

    只不过仍有一件事压在他心头。

    是那一位前辈，他的话此时此刻依旧在脑海里盘旋。

    自己是真的错过了真正的机缘了吗？
content_en:
Although he saw it, Li Xingtian did not go to get it immediately. Instead, he turned around again and said thanks:

    "Thank you, senior."

    Chu Xingchen waved his hand with a calm expression.

    Li Xingtian stood up slowly and walked straight towards the piece of thousand-year-old bone jade that he had been thinking about since his rebirth.

    Lifting the corner of the table and holding the stone-like Thousand-Year Bone Jade back in his hand, Li Xingtian felt as if a big stone in his heart had finally been let go.

    After thanking Chu Xingchen once again, Li Xingtian quickly exited the ruined temple with the thousand-year bone jade.

    Li Yingling looked at Li Xingtian leaving, then walked into the ruined temple, and said in a strange tone:

    "Master, you just let him go like this?"

    Master, who didn't want to move for no good reason, why was he so generous this time and let people take things and leave?

    Hearing Li Yingling's words, Chu Xingchen quickly stopped pretending to be a master: "You should practice at home first, and then go out for the teacher."

    Li Yingling showed the look that a master should have, but before Chu Xingchen left, she still asked curiously:

    "Master, is our sect really called Tiandao Alliance?"

    After all, what the master said was not always true, and he might have been lying to that stupid boy.

    "Yes." Chu Xingchen said a word and then turned into a burst of rainbow light and left.

    Li Yingling touched her chin and slowly thought about something.

    After a burst of spiritual power, the wooden sword flew automatically, and Li Yingling took it with his backhand.

    It's better to practice first, I'm almost getting started with this Three Thousand Weak Water Sword.

    Li Yingling always felt that this was a difficult thing to learn, but he made a qualitative leap after getting started.

    Li Yingling, who has been called a genius since he was a child, this is the first time he has lost his temper after being trained by this magical power.

    It’s been five whole days! I am actually still just wandering on the edge of entry.

    It's no wonder that the master is anxious to recruit new disciples. I guess my talent is not enough in the eyes of the master.

    Li Yingling sighed and tried harder.

    ——————

    Li Xingtian's goal was accurate and he headed straight for the nearest town.

    Refining this thousand-year-old bone jade requires quietness and a safe space, and it also takes a day.

    Whoever returns from the original Shadiao Sect will be mentally retarded, not to mention that he can't go back because he sneaked out of the sect secretly.

    Now he is probably labeled as a deserter by the sect.

    Go to a nearby town and open an inn. Give the waiters more money and don't bother yourself.

    After refining the thousand-year bone jade, he quickly headed to Zhongzhou, where there was still an opportunity that he could obtain now.

    But there was still one thing weighing on his mind.

    It was that senior, and his words were still swirling in his mind at this moment.

    Have you really missed your real opportunity?
